title: Lighthouse Pointe Marina
specs: Luxury Bentley pontoon and tritoon boats with Mercury 115hp and 150hp outboards
Pet-friendly with $50 non-refundable fee for pets under 30 lbs
Primary driver must be at least 21 years old with valid driver's license and credit card
If driver born on or after Jan 1, 1989, must present boater education card from Tennessee or equivalent
Any child under 13 must wear U.S.C.G. approved flotation device at all times onboard
Each person on towable tube must wear U.S.C.G approved personal flotation device; inflatable flotation devices prohibited
Pontoon boats hold up to 10 passengers including children

blurb: Lighthouse Pointe Marina offers well-maintained Bentley pontoon and tritoon boats for rent, equipped with safety gear, Bluetooth stereos, and bimini tops. Rentals include life preservers, safety equipment, and the first tank of gas. The marina also provides boat slips and storage options with gated access and amenities.
